name: Jinja

routes.outcome: Jinja MZO page states that Mailo, Leasehold and Freehold land-registration transactions are handled there and lists Jinja among districts covered. Local custodian evidence; no map/API endpoint.
MLHUD describes UgNLIS as spatially referenced land registration, valuation, planning and administration infrastructure and lists Jinja among its 22 MZOs.
Public Angular/Ionic portal HTML loaded. Main bundle reference was recovered.

Current JavaScript configuration exposed api.mlhud.go.ug/ugnlis-data-api/v1, api.mlhud.go.ug/ugnlis-api/v1, and https://gis.mlhud.go.ug/geoserver; cadastral-division-map route and parcel query route names were visible.
Anonymous request returned JSON internal-server-error; no schema or geometry.
Returned [] without parameters; not a citywide absence finding and no parcel geometry.

The Jinja MZO is local registry-custodian evidence; MLHUD Surveys and Mapping and UgNLIS are national agency/system evidence, not a qualified city adapter.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not constitute source integration/admission; runtime readiness remains held.
uncertainty: UgNLIS infrastructure and the Jinja MZO are current official evidence, but anonymous endpoint reachability, request schema, parcel coverage, native identity semantics, CRS, and update cadence remain unverified for Jinja. A serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter.
